name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The four hard Precedence clauses follow the task's ordered steps (find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, then pick up the ball), and the hard Existence(target_picked_up) is the last command. The hard chain forces key_found, has_matching_key, target_door_open and target_room_entered, so no earlier-step Existence is added. All clauses are hard, as the unhedged wording requires.

texts: Finding the matching key (key_found) must come before picking the key up.
Picking up the matching key must come before opening the locked door.
Opening the locked door must come before going into the target room.
Going into the target room must come before picking up the ball.
The agent must eventually pick up the target ball, which completes the task.
